target.task: Review whether the archived claim-refusal evaluator reaches claim handling at this revision.

actor.harness: Archived evaluator/worker with frozen test fixtures
actor.coverage: Coordinator deterministic execution and source review; no originating coding-agent trace

reviewer.assistance: Prior fresh Agent review exists; this retained record is coordinator-authored.

decision.requirement: A claim-refusal check must reach the claim branch before attributing a failure to its exit handling. This review does not authorize a live Noodle owner.
decision.mechanism: evaluate.py launches worker.py. atom.drive calls _run_owned; preclaim_base at issue_atom.py:6527 calls issue_execution.read_owner at 1852. read_owner at issue_execution.py:432-438 cannot load the fixture state.snapshot.json and raises AdmissionRefusal. _run_claim at issue_atom.py:6537 is not reached. worker.py handles AtomRefusal; this AdmissionRefusal escapes.
decision.consequence: The observed run is an evaluator/fixture failure, not evidence that nonzero claim handling violated its contract. The claim outcome in this run is unknown.
decision.alternative: For a narrow claim-contract test, isolate the preclaim seam as the current focused tests do. For integrated ordering coverage, supply complete disposable owner evidence that satisfies the preclaim contract.
decision.tradeoff: Narrow isolation is easier to diagnose but does not cover real owner-read integration. Complete disposable evidence increases realism and setup cost. Do not modify the archived frozen oracle and silently reuse its identity.

outcome.observed: Missing noodle.snapshot before _run_claim; two focused current tests passed in a separate coordinator check.
outcome.reason: Outcome was already known when this case was authored; no preregistered forecast.

lesson.applies_when: An evaluator fails before its target branch after the implementation adds or changes prerequisites.
lesson.counterexample: A test that reaches the branch and observes forbidden continuation after a nonzero claim requires investigating the product. It cannot be dismissed as this fixture defect.
lesson.next_check: On a future unseen task, predict the first failing boundary before running the check. Separately verify target-branch reachability and a planted violation.
lesson.promotion: Keep as a case and contextual review guidance. Existing owner validation already rejects missing snapshots; no global lint or live-owner requirement is justified.

role_feedback.debugging: Reconstruct first exception and branch reachability rather than blame the advertised test subject.
role_feedback.engineering_judgment: Keep oracle adequacy and product correctness separate.
role_feedback.architecture: Compare a narrow seam with integrated owner evidence.
role_feedback.reasoning_clarity: State the causal chain in decision.mechanism.
role_feedback.communication: Explain what the execution supports and the next discriminating check.
role_feedback.attention_to_detail: AdmissionRefusal and AtomRefusal are different exception boundaries.
role_feedback.developer_trust: Do not turn an unreached branch into a product verdict.

closure.product: Claim behavior unresolved by this evaluator run; separate focused tests provide narrower counterevidence. No product edit or lifecycle closure claimed.
closure.agent: Original coding-agent decisions not observed; this is agent-authored engineering analysis.
closure.evaluator: Fixture prerequisite failure observed. No evaluator repair performed.
gaps: No independent human judgment or calibration
